home_meta_title: Airbat – Wholesale hub for mobile top-ups
home_meta_description: Airbat connects businesses to prepaid airtime, data and digital vouchers from mobile operators worldwide through a single wholesale platform.
home_hero_title: Prepaid airtime and digital vouchers, wholesale and worldwide
home_hero_text: One connection gives your business access to mobile credit, data plans and voucher products from operators across the globe, priced for resellers, built for volume.
products_title: Everything prepaid, from a single catalogue
products_text: Add top-ups to your app, shop or payment network without negotiating with every operator. We handle the integrations, settlement and catalogue updates. You sell.
product_credit_text: Send prepaid credit straight to any supported mobile number in seconds.
product_data_text: Offer mobile internet packages in the sizes customers actually buy.
product_bundle_text: Minutes, SMS and data packaged together by the operator at one price.
product_offers_text: Time-limited deals and bonus credit, synced to your catalogue automatically.
benefit_title: A perk your international workforce will use
benefit_text_1: Many employees send money home or keep in touch with family abroad. Prepaid credit for their home network is a practical, appreciated reward.
benefit_text_2: Construction, logistics, hospitality and care providers use Airbat vouchers as staff incentives, seasonal gifts and onboarding bonuses.
audiences_title: Built for businesses that move prepaid at scale
audiences_text: Whether you resell, embed or reward, Airbat plugs into the way you already work.
audience_distributors_text: Widen your range across borders without signing dozens of operator contracts.
audience_operators_text: Reach diaspora customers abroad and grow inbound top-up revenue.
audience_superapps_text: Add a high-frequency product that brings users back every month.
audience_retail_text: Sell top-ups at the till and from point-of-sale terminals in every store.
audience_creators_text: Let fans reward creators, or pay out creators, with mobile credit.
audience_ewallets_text: Give wallet balances an everyday use case your customers understand.
audience_remittance_text: Pair cross-border transfers with airtime delivered to the recipient's phone.
platform_access_text: One API and one portal for the entire catalogue, no per-operator setup.
platform_funding_text: Top up your balance in the way that suits you and transact around the clock.
platform_scale_text: Infrastructure sized for peak traffic, with monitoring that keeps transactions flowing.
offices_title: Based in Prague, at the heart of Europe
offices_text: From Prague we serve partners across Europe and beyond.
europe_map_label: Map of Europe centred on Prague, with major European hubs within about {distance} km
location_central_text: Prague sits in the middle of Europe, a short flight or train ride from the continent's key markets.
location_timezone_text: Working on CET, our business hours overlap with Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
location_eu_text: As an EU-based company we work under EU rules, including GDPR and SEPA payments.
location_reach_text: Quick to reach partners and operators in Western, Central and Eastern Europe.
cta_title: Let's find the right setup for your business
cta_point_1: A dedicated contact from first call to go-live
cta_point_2: Pricing based on your volume and markets
contact_meta_description: Get in touch with the Airbat team about wholesale prepaid products.
contact_text: Questions about products, pricing or integration? Send us a message and the right person will get back to you.
